TraitDescription: Yangjiang douchi begins the recipe and uses the Large amount to form its deep savory base.
Ginger follows the douchi and uses the Medium amount to add warmth.
Dried tangerine peel follows the ginger and uses the Small amount to brighten the finish.
Coarse salt comes last and uses the Very Small amount to support the other flavors.
